title: 数绷带：衡量AI节省的时间
summary: 论文区分“秒表视角”与“账本视角”来评估AI节省的时间，提出无模型指标：节省时间与逃逸缺陷超额量，以及盈亏平衡缺陷成本。复现METR开发者研究显示减速19%~24%，并指出过度信任会以更多总耗时换取表面提速。
summary_en: The paper contrasts a stopwatch view of AI time savings with a ledger view that weighs saved time against escaped defects, proposing model-free metrics: time saved, excess escaped defects, and break-even defect cost. Replicating METR's developer study, it finds a 19%-24% slowdown and shows over-trust trades clock minutes for larger total costs.
